$meta.note: Interface wording for the browser prototype. Every string is a stand-in for the owner to replace or approve.

text.title: Life Is A Game
text.subtitle: Yaba prototype
text.confirmNew: Start a new game? Your saved game will be replaced.
text.gistEmpty: Nothing to report yet. Give it time.
text.dontKnowWay: You don't know the way to {place} yet.
text.feel.neutral: Neither here nor there about you
text.rel.familiarity.up: You and {name} know each other better
text.fx.knows: You now know the way to {place}
text.intro.title: Meet Tobi
text.intro.body: Tobi Adeyemi just moved to Yaba with his guitar and a few naira. He carries loads at the market to get by, but he came to Lagos to play music.
text.intro.goal: His goal: land his first paid gig.
text.coach.you: This is you, Tobi. The yellow ring follows you everywhere.
text.coach.walk: Tap any street or place to walk there. Drag to look around.
text.coach.quest: Your goal right now. Tap "Show me" when you're not sure where to go.
text.coach.time: Time runs by itself. Pause it, speed it up, zoom or turn the view here. 🎥 follows Tobi at street level.
text.coach.gist: Gist: what's happening around Yaba, and why.
text.dontKnowYet: You don't know the way yet. Ask people around.
text.hint.explore: Have a look around: tap a street to walk.
text.hint.unknownPlace: You don't know the way to {place} yet. Ask the people you meet.
text.hint.atTarget: You're in the right place. Give it a moment.
text.hint.beThereAt: Be at {place} from {from}. It's a {mins} min walk.
text.hint.closed: {place} is closed now. Come back later.
text.hint.waitFor: {name} should be here at {place}. Stay around.
text.hint.meetNow: {name} is at {place} right now. {mins} min walk.
text.hint.meetLater: {name} will be at {place} from {from}. Go and say hello.
text.hint.askAround: {name} might be able to help. Ask around where to find them.
text.menu.title: Back to title
text.flag.tip:gig_leads: Ada told you where to find gig leads
text.flag.lead:gig_live_spot: Uncle Tunde will give you a slot at Bluelight
text.flag.lead:gig_duet: Ada wants you to sing a duet with her
text.flag.tip:stall: You learned how market stalls really change hands
text.flag.contact:office: You now have a contact at the Island offices
text.flag.musician:paid: You got paid to play music
text.flag.trader:stall_open: You have your own market stall
text.followOn: Following Tobi. Drag or double-tap to go back to the city view.
text.graphicsSet: Graphics: {level}. Shadows and smoothing change after a reload.
text.fx.goalMine: You got something you were after
